//overrides: Force a single copy of every wasm-bindgen module tree-wide: two copies give
two class identities and break `instanceof` checks during proving. On the v8
line this block pinned @midnight-ntwrk/ledger-v8; on the ledger-v9 line the
ledger moved to @midnightntwrk/ledger-v9 (NOTE the scope has no hyphen).
compact-runtime is pinned too because the versions disagree only in name:
5.0.0-beta.7 pins 0.19.0-rc.0. The two published tarballs differ in three
lines (the version string, its source map and package.json) and nothing
else, and the runtime guard strips the prerelease suffix — so collapsing
them onto 0.19.0 is safe and avoids a second onchain-runtime wasm copy.
onchain-runtime-v4 is pinned for the same reason one level down: today
`4.0.0-rc.3` agree, but a released 4.0.0 would split them.
